playstyle: Hit-and-run. Poke with fast, hard-to-punish mids and highs, step and backdash out of the opponent's answers, and punish whiffs from far away. When you need damage, go into Destructive Form (DES) for chainsaw pressure, which gets nastier in Heat.

stances.name: Destructive Form
stances.note: Chainsaws out. Many moves enter it with 1+2 (4, f+2, f+4, f,f,F+2, d+3+4). DES.f+1 is +3 on block and DES.1+2 is +4; DES.d+2 is her low.

stances.name: Boot
stances.note: Flying stance. f+1+2, uf+1, b+4,4 and ws2 can transition into it with 3 or 4. Linear: sidestep it to her right.

stances.name: Dual Boot
stances.note: Two-boot flight. DBT.1 is +9 on block. The same moves enter it with f+3 or f+4 instead of 3 or 4.

stances.name: Backup
stances.note: Backsway. BKP.2 and BKP.4 tornado on hit; you can also do while-standing moves out of it.

combos.name: Launch BnB: u+1 T! f,F u+1
combos.situation: After any regular launch (Wavu lists df+2 or uf+4,4).
mistakes: Pressing u+1 too early after the launcher: wait until they are high in the air.
Missing the dash: tap f,F quickly before the last u+1.
